name: Ses Finques Ibiza — property management
when: Year-round · for owners who aren't here all winter
desc: Mayte looks after houses whose owners live elsewhere: regular inspections, maintenance coordination, garden and pool care, the house ready and warm before you land, plus the paperwork — bills, invoices, payments — and rental management if you let it out. The person you call when the gardener says there's water where there shouldn't be.

name: 24nannies — event, hotel & villa nannies
when: On request · a night, a week or a whole stay
desc: A Dutch agency with twelve years of placing nannies with families, villas, hotels and events, on the island as well as at home: a sitter for Saturday night, a nanny for the week the grandparents visit, childcare at a wedding or a company dinner so the grown-ups can stay at the table. Nannies are reference-checked, hold a certificate of conduct and have child first aid. Ask for a quote with your dates.
status: Books for Ibiza all year — ask early for Christmas and New Year

name: Tante Will — your Dutch aunties on Ibiza
when: On request · evenings, days, holiday weeks
desc: Started as one Dutch babysitter, Auntie Will herself; now a small team of Dutch girls who live on the island. Not nannies — aunties: experienced, caring, and there for the night you want to go out, the school holidays and the week the family comes to stay. Dutch and English with the little ones. Send your dates by Instagram, WhatsApp or the website and let the fun begin.

name: Homegirlz — extra hands for home, boat or event
type: Family & kids · private cooking · PA · events & retreats · boat
when: On request · by the hour, one girl or two · mix & match
price: From €20/h (family & home) · cooking €35/h · PA €35/h · events & retreats €30/h · boat €40/h; two girls from €40/h
desc: Two Dutch girls on the island who do whatever the day needs: babysitting and family support, cooking for the table (they've catered a whole mother-and-daughter retreat), personal assistance — reservations, shopping, the villa ready before you land — hands at your event or retreat, and the boat stocked and hosted for a day at sea. Combine what you need on the same day; they quote exact prices. 30% deposit, free cancellation up to 72 h before.

name: Kimberley the Fairy — kids' birthday parties
when: On request · birthdays and family parties
desc: The dance teacher from Thursday's kids' classes, in fairy form: an hour or two of dancing, games, music and a bit of magic that keeps a houseful of 4-to-11-year-olds happy while the parents get to finish a conversation. Tell her the age, the number and the date.
